intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个明显信号：围绕 AI 编程代理的配套工具正在快速细分，从免费接入多模型、到让代理像同事一样接任务、再到用强模型写计划给弱模型执行，大家不再只卷模型本身，而是卷怎么把代理用得更省、更顺、更可控。
intro.en: Today's projects point to a clear shift: the tooling around AI coding agents is fragmenting fast. Instead of competing on models, builders are racing to make agents cheaper to run, easier to coordinate, and more controllable,

zh.summary: 把 Claude Code、Codex 等 12 种代理客户端路由到 61 家模型提供商，包括免费和本地模型，保留原生流式与工具调用。解决的是开发者想用熟悉代理界面却受限于单一模型和额度的问题。
zh.insight: 适合做团队内部的模型网关：统一管理密钥、额度和路由策略，按项目切换免费或付费后端。和直接改代理源码相比，胜在不绑定具体客户端。

en.summary: Routes 12 agent harnesses, including Claude Code and Codex, to 61 model providers such as free and local ones, while preserving native streaming and tool use.
en.insight: A natural fit for an internal model gateway: centralize keys, quotas, and routing, and switch backends per project.

items.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)

zh.summary: 一个可自托管的工作空间，把 issue 分配给 AI 编码代理，代理会领任务、报进度、提阻塞并交回评审。解决的是多个代理各占一个终端、上下文反复丢失、协作无记录的问题。
zh.insight: 可以切「小团队代理项目看板」场景：把现有 CLI 代理接进看板，让非工程成员也能派活和验收。和纯聊天式代理相比，差在任务状态和交接是可追踪的。

en.summary: A self-hostable workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents that pick them up, report progress, raise blockers, and hand back for review.
en.insight: Target small teams that want an agent project board: plug existing CLI agents in so non-engineers can assign and review work.

items.description: Make humans and AI agents work as one team — open-source and self-hostable.

zh.summary: 面向交互式多模态与语音的高性能服务运行时，支持 ASR、音频和音乐生成，提供 OpenAI 兼容 API。解决的是语音和多模态模型上线时缺乏统一推理底座的问题。
zh.insight: 更适合作为基础设施信号：做语音代理的团队可基于它自建推理层，按并发和延迟调优。和通用推理框架相比，差在对音频链路和流式交互的原生支持。

en.summary: A high-performance serving runtime for interactive multimodal and speech workloads, covering ASR, audio, and music generation behind an OpenAI-compatible API.
en.insight: Best read as infrastructure: teams building voice agents can self-host this layer and tune for concurrency and latency.

items.description: High Performance Serving Runtime For Interactive Super Intelligence System
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: GPU 加速的 IDE 兼终端复用器，内置语言智能，多实例组成端到端加密网络，可从任意设备连回工作站。解决的是代理自动编程和人工编程割裂、远程开发体验差的问题。
zh.insight: 可面向「一人多机」的独立开发者做远程代理工作台：在笔记本上盯任务，重活跑在台式机。和 VS Code Remote 相比，差在把代理编排和终端复用做进同一层。

en.summary: A GPU-accelerated IDE and terminal multiplexer with built-in language intelligence, where instances form an end-to-end encrypted network so you can reach your workstation from any…
en.insight: Target solo developers with multiple machines: a remote agent workbench where you monitor from a laptop while heavy work runs on a desktop.

items.description: a fast, GPU-accelerated, full-featured IDE and terminal multiplexer, suitable both for automatic and manual programming.

zh.summary: 纯 Rust 从零写的开源下载管理器，跨三平台，支持多线程加速、磁力链接和浏览器扩展，无广告无注册。解决的是 IDM 类工具收费、闭源且跨平台支持差的问题。
zh.insight: 可切「团队批量素材下载」场景：把浏览器扩展和 CLI 结合，做可脚本化的下载队列与校验。和 IDM 相比，差在开源可审计、能嵌进自动化流程。

en.summary: A clean-room Rust download manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux with multi-threaded acceleration, magnet links, and a browser extension, free of ads and sign-ups.
en.insight: Target teams downloading media in bulk: combine the extension with a CLI for scriptable queues and checksums.

items.description: misterdownloadmanager: The ultimate open-source, clean-room download manager written from scratch in pure Rust for Windows, Mac, and Linux

zh.summary: 本地打开代理生成的 HTML 文件，可点选元素和文本、编辑 Mermaid 白板，并把反馈发回给代理。解决的是人机围绕 HTML 产物协作时只能靠截图和长段文字描述的问题。
zh.insight: 适合做「代理产物的可视化批注层」，面向用代理生成原型或报表的团队：把点选反馈变成结构化指令。和聊天里描述修改相比，差在保留 HTML 的交互性。

en.summary: Opens agent-generated HTML locally so you can pinpoint elements and text, edit Mermaid whiteboards, and send feedback back to the agent.
en.insight: Build a visual annotation layer for agent output, aimed at teams generating prototypes or reports: turn point-and-click feedback into structured instructions.

items.description: HTML is the new markdown. Lavish is the new editor for your HTML artifacts.

zh.summary: 基于 Next.js 的影视聚合搜索与播放站，支持多采集源并行搜索、HLS 播放、IPTV 和进度同步，可 Docker 一键部署。解决的是自建影视站门槛高、源管理混乱的问题。
zh.insight: 可切「家庭媒体中心或垂直片库」场景，重点做源健康度管理和合规内容接入，而非公开聚合。和现成 CMS 相比，差在跨源聚合与自动换源测速。

en.summary: A Next.js movie and TV aggregation site with parallel multi-source search, HLS playback, IPTV, and progress sync, deployable via Docker.
en.insight: Aim at home media centers or niche catalogs, focusing on source health and licensed content rather than public aggregation.

items.description: 一分钟搭建影视站，支持Docker等部署方式

zh.summary: 仅凭用户名在数千个网站收集账号线索并汇总成人物档案，无需 API key。解决的是调查、尽职调查和反欺诈中跨平台身份拼图耗时的问题。
zh.insight: 可切「招聘背调或品牌侵权初筛」场景，把结果做成可导出报告，并加置信度和误报标注。和手工逐站搜索相比，差在批量与可复现。

en.summary: Collects a person's account trail across thousands of sites from a username alone, with no API keys. It saves the hours spent piecing together cross-platform identities for…
en.insight: Aim at recruiting background checks or brand infringement triage: turn output into exportable reports with confidence scores and false-positive flags.

items.description: 🕵️‍♂️ Collect a dossier on a person by username from 6K websites

zh.summary: OpenAI 的代码安全 CLI 与 TypeScript SDK，能扫描仓库、验证候选漏洞、生成补丁并校验修复，还能起草 SECURITY.md。解决的是 AI 生成代码增多后安全审查跟不上的问题。
zh.insight: 适合接进 CI 做「变更级安全门禁」，只扫 Git diff 并自动开修复 PR，面向没有专职安全的小团队。和传统 SAST 相比，差在会验证和修补而非只报错。

en.summary: OpenAI's security CLI and TypeScript SDK scan repos, validate candidate findings, generate patches, verify fixes, and draft SECURITY.md.
en.insight: Wire it into CI as a change-level security gate that scans only the Git diff and opens fix PRs, for small teams without dedicated security.

items.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security

zh.summary: 一个代理技能，用最强模型审计代码库并写出实施计划，再交给更便宜的模型执行，自身不写实现。解决的是高能力模型贵、低能力模型乱改的错配问题。
zh.insight: 适合包装成「代码库体检+分阶段改造计划」服务，面向维护老项目的团队：先出可评审的 markdown 计划，再按预算分批执行。和直接让代理改代码相比，风险前置。

en.summary: An agent skill that uses your strongest model to audit a codebase and write implementation plans for cheaper models to execute, without implementing anything itself.
en.insight: Package it as a codebase health check plus phased refactor plan for teams maintaining legacy projects: reviewable markdown first, budgeted execution later.

items.description: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
